license_evidence: Archived author_model_provenance.json explicitly records repository license not located and exclusion from earlier public structure ZIP. No new upstream permission claim is made.
scientific_scope: Author predicted/MD model and historical derived receptor; no new molecular dynamics or docking executed during recovery.
original_processing_steps: Fetch the fixed author-model coordinate URL and require SHA256 of the original PDB before processing.
Load human AFDB canonical Q8TDI8 v6 and mouse AFDB canonical Q8R4P5 v6 plus frozen human UniProt transmembrane features and mouse-human residue map.
Original src/prepare_receptors_v2.py reads ATOM/HETATM and removes H/D; sequence alignment uses Biopython global PairwiseAligner, BLOSUM62, open_gap_score=-10 and extend_gap_score=-0.5.
Fit equal-residue conserved transmembrane C-alpha pairs to the human reference using Kabsch rigid rotation; preserve all original heavy atoms and write PDB coordinates with 0.001 angstrom precision.

Parameterize aligned heavy coordinates using the original Meeko 0.8.0 mk_prepare_receptor command: mk_prepare_receptor.exe --read_pdb screen_v2/inputs/receptors/M_PUB_ALL_aligned_heavy.pdb -o screen_v2/inputs/receptors/M_PUB_ALL -p -j --write_pdb screen_v2/inputs/receptors/M_PUB_ALL_H.pdb.
Require SHA256 c024cc9efaf910ac11642cea4a4c701a0a88a335d7deb0d040320516d5a2eda1 on the resulting PDBQT before replay; newly fetched or rebuilt inputs are not presumed byte-identical until checked.
